Variants.Content: The Church of the Seven Gods consists of churches, monks, nuns, archbishops and shrines throughout the seven kingdoms. It has land, donations, bells, marriage records and educational influence. The nobility needed the church to legitimize marriages, coronations, and funerals, while commoners sought refuge in the church Protection, food, confession and charity. The Church was not a purely spiritual institution divorced from politics: it possessed wealth and was divided by the pressures of the Crown, the nobility, and the common people. The white walls of the church may symbolize order, but the crowd outside the church door will turn their faith into protest and judgment. The specific church leaders are variable, but the church as a cross-territorial institution remains unchanged.
